notes.title: Exciting Projects + Great Deals! Don’t Miss the Bundle Discounts This Sale!
notes.content:
[h2]News Post Content[/h2]

Hello, fellow adventurers!
We’re thrilled to share updates on exciting new projects alongside fantastic deals during the Steam Autumn Sale!

[h2]Sales and Bundle Savings![/h2]

First, let’s talk about deals! All our games are discounted in the Steam Autumn Sale, and this is the perfect time to build your collection. Want an even better deal? Check out our Bundle, where you’ll get an extra 15% off when buying multiple games together. It’s the best way to dive into our magical worlds and save big!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43994/Gemcrafts_Hidden_Cat_Bundle/

[h2]What’s Next for Purrfectly Hidden Cats?[/h2]

Fans of the Purrfectly Hidden Cats series, rejoice! Our partners at Bleeding Moon Studio are working hard on the next entry in the series. While it’s still early in development, we’re excited to hint that it’ll be full of playful challenges, charming secrets, and—you guessed it—more adorable hidden cats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840768/61ff6c3de61599583f969eb4d2385ddf4680dca4.png[/img]

[h2]A Secret New Project[/h2]

We’re also collaborating with Horny Tales on a mysterious new project. While we can’t share much yet, we promise it’ll be something completely different and full of surprises. Stay tuned for more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840768/b4951724f5a36b2e9bd9c0de309154a33868a9a9.png[/img]

[h2]Thank You for Your Support![/h2]

Finally, a huge thank-you to everyone who’s played Kittenrock and supported our games. We love creating these magical experiences for you, and your enthusiasm keeps us going. If you’ve enjoyed any of our games, consider leaving a review—it helps us immensely and means the world to us.

Don’t miss out on the Steam Autumn Sale and the extra savings in our Bundle. Happy gaming, and we’ll see you in the next adventure!

Cheers,
The Gemcraft Games Team

Happy gaming, and may your cat-finding adventures be purrfect! 🐾

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Social Chatter Achievement fix.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is a small patch aimed at improving the triggering mechanism for Achievements, specifically to address the persistent issue where the Social Chatter Achievement (click all humans) fails to activate to some players. We hope this update will completely eradicate the problem. While the fix has worked for us, we recommend that those who have encountered this issue perform a full reset from within the game after applying the update.

Thank you, and we apologize for any inconvenience caused by this bug.

Gemcraft Games Team
